name: Claude-Agent
description: The browser Anthropic hosts for Claude products, including Claude Duet, to complete tasks at a user's direction — what the operator calls agentic browser use. Requests come from a real browser running on Anthropic's infrastructure, so this is user-directed page access rather than crawling, and the operator documents it separately from its robots (ClaudeBot, Claude-User and Claude-SearchBot), noting that a site's preferences for the two are independent. Allowing or blocking it decides whether a site's own visitors can ask Claude to carry out tasks on that site.

instances: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko; compatible; Claude-Agent/1.0) Chrome/154.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
